newsitem.title: USA: Litton unit wins potential $693 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Litton unit wins potential $693 mln contract.

text.p: Litton Industries Inc's PRC subsidiary Wednesday said it has been named as one of three winners of a contract for the purchase of support hardware and software to the Military Health Service System.
Litton's contract has a potential cumulative total of $693.4 million and covers a two-year period, the company said in a statement.

The contract, called a Support Hardware and Automation Related Products -- Generic (Sharp(G), calls for PRC to provide state-of-the-art computer servers, operating systems, development tools and software for use at locations worldwide.
